prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production premium dark fantasy painted 2.5D Unity monster atlas. Square 2x2 sprite sheet, EXACTLY FOUR complete independent full-body poses of the SAME monster, each centered in its own quadrant. Real alpha transparency. NO text, labels, dividers, floor, cast shadows or background. Orthographic 3/4 camera slightly overhead, facing screen right, consistent body scale, matching local feet baseline. Top-left idle, top-right anticipation, bottom-left attack strike, bottom-right walk. ALL body, weapons, hair stay central 65% of EACH quadrant with at least 60px transparent gutters around center divisions and outer edges. Highly detailed hand-painted materials, readable silhouette, colored shadows and restrained luminous edge light, no plastic toys, no chibi. Subject: corrupted harpy huntress, feral feminine avian face with ivory feather crest, hooked talon feet clearly touching baseline, compact folded raven wings with layered obsidian and burgundy feathers kept INSIDE the quadrant, tarnished bronze breastplate and waist chains, amber eyes, small curved talon blades, sleek agile crouching silhouette. Rich tactile feather layering and painted armor details. Wings partly folded in every pose, never a wide wingspan crossing quadrant.
edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Sprite atlas correction ONLY. Preserve exact same hand-painted corrupted harpy, armor, feather colors and four poses. Four poses in square 2x2 sheet, center each. At least 80 pixels genuinely transparent margin all sides of EACH quadrant. Bottom-left blade must not cross the central vertical divider. No extra figures, no backdrop, no ground shadows, no text. Real alpha transparency; retain detailed art.
